hard_fail_reasons: Compact workshop chair: v002 still misses its approved material character; its visible surfaces remain procedural, and the gameplay framing defect persists. The low crest/back relationship also weakens chair recognition within the authoritative 19-inch height.
incumbent_comparison: Compared with v001, v002 improves the room-interior framing and its darkened wood is marginally less pale, but the approved timber response remains unmet. The low-back shape still fails to read as the spindle chair in the target.
next_action_hypothesis: Use a per-asset procedural wood-grain ShaderMaterial with anisotropic board grain and a satin response; size gameplay framing from the tall axis; preserve the target and the authored RoomDefinition envelope.
